entries.name: Visual Basic .NET
entries.definition: Microsoft's object-oriented version of the Visual Basic language for the .NET platform.

entries.name: Wagdi
entries.definition: An Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Vagad region of southern Rajasthan, India, and nearby areas.

entries.name: Walloon
entries.definition: A Romance language spoken in Wallonia, the French-speaking part of Belgium.

entries.name: X3D
entries.definition: An ISO standard, XML-based format and language for describing interactive 3D scenes for the web, the successor to VRML.

entries.name: XBRL
entries.definition: An XML-based standard language for tagging and exchanging business and financial reporting data.

entries.name: Xhosa
entries.definition: A Bantu language spoken mainly in South Africa, where it is one of the official languages.

entries.name: XML
entries.definition: A markup language for structured documents.

entries.name: XUL
entries.definition: An XML-based language from Mozilla for describing the user interface of applications such as Firefox.

entries.name: Yoruba
entries.definition: A Niger-Congo language spoken mainly in southwestern Nigeria and in Benin and Togo.

entries.name: Zulu
entries.definition: A Bantu language spoken mainly in South Africa, one of its official languages.
